description: This file defines a PHP trait 'ControllerTrait' within the OrangeHRM project, providing utility methods for controller operations such as forwarding requests, obtaining the current request, and handling redirects in a web application.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Forwards the current request to another controller, creating a sub-request and handling it through the application's kernel.

methods.name: getCurrentRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the current HTTP request from the request stack.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Generates a redirect response to the specified path, constructing the full URL based on the current request's scheme and host.
